code.note: 06_simulation run_pipeline.run in-process (seed 0, single mother, step 6 on main), observation written with io_utils.write_run_folder and read with estimation.sim_outputs.read_sim_output; estimate() with its defaults (thermal fitted, air_prior ground, building temperature = the run's step 6 driver, the 72 h memory of KNMI 344 hourly T; deformation report (motion building) or scatterer (motion scatterer); layers 20 m, 40 m, two, one, and at least 500 / 1000 points per layer; building_id groups), single_epoch_profiles (ground background, boundary mean). truth = layer means of the run's 1 m N; station = ground N carried up with -55 N/km. fit: est - mean(truth) = slope * (truth - mean(truth)) + intercept per layer, least squares.
